tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently stayed at a resort during your semester break and enjoyed the overall experience. However, you encountered some issues with your stay. You want to provide feedback to the resort manager, Ms. Garcia, to address these concerns. Write an email to Ms. Garcia.
bullets: Mention what you enjoyed about your stay at the resort.
Describe the issues you had with your stay.
Suggest ways to improve the service.
tasks.subject: Feedback on recent stay
